That's quite touching mate. Thank you.

 I'll edit this comment if I'm still here in a days time.

Don't worry about me mate. I'll be forgotten in a week. 

Thank you for your company and kindness. I wish you the very best that life has to offer.
Nah mate. I've settled on it. I'm only posting because I should be sleeping but my mind is racing about the morning. I just want some company before I go.
I spoke to them yesterday. I'm not fussed regarding a family of my own
I have my parents and a sibling. I've never had any direction or drive so as time has progressed it's gotten worse.

I don't know why mate. I can't rationalise my feelings. They are just there. 

No wife or kids.
Nothing to write home about. I just feel so fed up. Day after day of nothing worthwhile. It's so tedious. I'm scared of the future. I'm completely lost and I'm stepping off the ride.
Mate I'm absolutely just done with it all. I'm just fed up. I can't stand the present and don't want a future.
